newsitem.title: USA: Wholesale prices rise 0.3 percent in August.
newsitem.headline: Wholesale prices rise 0.3 percent in August.

text.p: Wholesale prices rose moderately in August, the government said Thursday, posting the biggest gain in six months amid Wall Street fears that a strong economy could ignite inflation.

The Labor Department said the Producer Price Index edged up 0.3 percent last month, after showing no change in July. But after factoring out volatile food and energy costs, the closely watched "core" PPI fell 0.1 percent in August after rising 0.1 percent in July.
